basis: narrative-writer v9 'Keep the chat from clutter' and v8 Cyrus rule (both apply from level_18 on, so none of these levels breaks a brief rule; this is a judgement on player feel). Bible: Clue rules, Story beats ('Cyrus stops double-checking'), Callbacks.
index_note: Line indices are 0-based script[] positions in dialogue_level_XX.json.

levels.player_read: Direct, but that's the stated style. The sushi-section exchange (script[10]-[13]) is the origin of the sushi_day callback and carries real warmth for Mina, so it earns its length. Only two lines read as pure echo.

levels.round_robin: Yes, structurally. After the craving, script[4]-[18] works through one need block per friend: budget (4-7), peanut (8-9), vegetarian (10-15), dairy (16-18), with only script[16] as a breather. Mina's 'how's everyone's week been?' (script[7]) is answered by Cyrus's peanut homework instead of anyone's week.
levels.cyrus_lecture: Mild. script[8] has Cyrus raise his own allergy and explain his stall research ('Satay and I have history, so that stall is crossed out'). It's in voice and implied, but it is the self-explaining pattern v8 retires. A v9 rework could give it to a friend ('already crossed off the satay grill'), as level_18 does.
levels.player_read: The most naggy of the five. The fries-patrol bit is funny, but it runs six lines (10-15): a setup, a question, the story, Mina's reply, Liam's rules, and Mina agreeing to them. Two more agreement lines echo needs (script[9], script[15]). Cutting lines alone still leaves almost nothing between the craving and the sign-off that isn't a need, so this wants a rewrite, not a trim.

Peanut survives on script[8] (or a friend's line), vegetarian on the merged fries line plus script[14], dairy on script[17]-[18] (Bun Stop's cheese). The fries-patrol joke survives in one line; what goes is the Roxy question and answer and Mina's 'they were really good fries' (keep script[13] if there's room; it's lovely Mina voice).

levels.round_robin: Mild: after the stall payoff, budget (5-7), peanut (8-11), healthy (12-13) and dairy (14-16) run in turn. Each is anchored in something real (coin purse, 'the question', grandma, the tipster), so it reads as conversation rather than announcements.
levels.cyrus_lecture: Yes: script[10] is exactly the pattern v8 retires, with Cyrus listing wok oil, crunchy toppings and shared woks. It's also the line that reads most naggy across all five levels. Sundial's peanut oil, the precision trap, is fully evidenced in its review ('a spoonful of roasted peanut oil from the big tin'), so a broad friend line is enough.
levels.player_read: Good premise and banter (the slurp tip, coins only, grandma's greens). The clutter is concentrated: a Cyrus lecture plus an echo on peanut, and a two-callback dairy pair where Liam dwells on the milkshake.

levels.loses_if_trimmed: Nothing scored. Peanut keeps script[9] (satay callback) and script[11] (broad 'any form'), and Brass Kettle and Sundial are both decided by their reviews. Dairy keeps script[14] and script[16], and Kestrel's milk broth is explicit in its review. Callback lines drop from 4 to 3. The loss is the detail of Cyrus's routine; script[8] ('I ask the cook one question') still shows his careful side in one line.

overall.recommendation: Don't run a full v9 rework across the five. Only level_13 merits one: its middle is a sequence of need blocks with a six-line callback cluster, and trimming alone can't put banter back. level_08, level_10, level_14 and level_15 are fine with two-line hand edits (level_15 needs two small wording changes so the remaining lines still connect). level_15's Cyrus lecture (script[10]) is the most naggy single line in the set and is the best-value cut. level_08 is lowest priority: it's a stated level and reads as intended.
overall.after_edits: Each edit changes an approved level's dialogue, so re-run the Validator (check 12 doesn't apply; these are implied/stated) and the critic. For level_13 (rework) also run a blind playtest round, since clue lines move. No clue line that a trap depends on is removed in any proposal above.
overall.rule_status: No level breaks a current brief rule: the clutter and Cyrus rules apply from level_18 on. These are feel improvements, Gabriella's call.
